content: Yosep ivotia tauu pa tooghŋa ve taazi

Yuda isavia saveeŋ tane, le Yosep irau ipariaaŋ tauu pa taŋiiz muul mako. Tauvene isaav aliiŋa tiina pa yes uraata tooni tau yesŋa tiyozyooz na, ighe: “Yam asov avot ala muuri!” Yes tivot tila, ve i tomania tooghŋa ve taazi zigazi tileep, ra ivotia tauu pazi.
I itaŋ toman aliiŋa tiina. Tauvene tamtamon siriv to Isip tau tileep tigharau zi na, tilooŋa ve tila tipaesia vaaru pa kinik.
Yosep isaav pa tooghŋa ve taazi ighe: “Yau Yosep! Taug tane! Onoon, tamaŋ ilepleep?” Eemon yes irau tiyol aliiŋa mako. Pasaa, tirur le toozi ilale.

Tauvene Yosep isaav pazi muul ighe: “Alam agharau ghau.” Yes tila tigharauu, ve i isaav pazi muul ighe: “Yau Yosep! Yau tazimim tau muuŋ yam agholi ghau nala to yes zeran to raukoliiŋ. Zeran tawe, ta tigham ghau nalam naleep izi Isip.

Eemon lolomim ipataŋan ve avasuku saveeŋ pa taumim sov. Onoon, yam agholi ghau. Tauta tigham ghau nalam naleep ta sene. Eemon yam agham ŋgar tana sorok mako. Maaron tauu, ta imbaaŋ ghau namuuŋ payam nalam. Leso nauul tamtamon katini ve timaat sov, ve nakis zi tileep matazi yaryaare.
Pitool tane igheen irau ndaman ru wa. Ve ndamana liim paam ighengheen naghoon soone. Ndaman liim tana, pale vazoghiiŋ aniiŋ mako, ve taitaiŋ mako paam.
“Maaron imbaaŋ ghau namuuŋ payam nalam to nauul gham, leso amaat sov. Tauta aazne, aleep poi. Ve murei paam, paaghu tsiam pale tileep poi, ve iseeŋga tauvene taghon taghon gha ila.
Tauvene yam ambaaŋ ghau nalam nugh tane mako. Maaron tauu, ta imbaaŋ ghau nalam. Ve i ighur ghau namin daaba pa kinik uraat tooni. Tauta aazne, naŋgin gabua tooni naol isov tomania taan isov to Isip.

“Yau naghe yam rekia amuul ala to tamaŋ, ve asavia aliŋag pani aghe: ‘Natum Yosep aliiŋa ilat payo ighe: ‘Maaron ighur ghau namin tiina, ve naŋgin taan dodoli to Isip. Yau naghe yo upul taan Kanaan, ve rekia mon uzilam tsiau. Uzuar sov.
Tauvene yamŋa natumŋa ve timbumŋa, asov aburig, ve ayau ŋgai tsiam tomania yauyauŋ tsiam naol isov, ve alam. Leso aleep agharau ghau izi taan sirivu to Gosen.
Pa pitool tiina tane, ndaman liim ighengheen soone. Eemon yau taug pale naŋgin gham pa aniiŋ. Tauvene yamŋa tamtamon tsio irau ambool pa gabua eta mako.’”
Ra Yosep isaav pazi muul ighe: “Yam asov aghit katin ghau wa. Ve tazig Benyamin paam, i ighit ghau. Yau Yosep. Taug ta nasavsaav tomani gham ne.

Tauvene yam ala ve asaav pa tamaŋ tauvene: ‘Natum Yosep eeza imin tiina kat izi taan Isip.’ Ve apaes pani pa gabua naol isov tau yam aghita izi nugh tane. Mako aghamu ve rekia mon amuul azilam tsiau.”
I isavsaav pazi le isov, ve yesuru taazi Benyamin tivasaghavu zi, ve titaŋ.
Ra Yosep isaghav tooghŋa tisov, ve yesŋa titaŋ. Titaŋ le isov, ra lolozi poia ve avozi ibees.
Saawe tau kinik to Isip yesŋa uraata tooni tilooŋ tighe toŋvetaz to Yosep tila tivot tooni, ene igham zi lolozi poia.
Tauvene kinik isaav pa Yosep ighe: “Usaav pa tazim ve toghamŋa to tipadid aniiŋ izala doŋki toozi, ve timuul tila pa taan Kanaan.
Mako tigham tamamim, tomania azuwazŋa ve natuzŋa, ve yesŋa timuul tilam tivot tsiau. Yau aat napul taan sirivu to Isip tau poia kat na imin lezi. Leso tileep poi, ve lezi aniiŋ popoia katini.
Ve usavia aliŋag pazi tauvene: Yes aat tigham karis siriv to Isip ve tila. Leso tighur tamamim tomania azuwazŋa ve natuzŋa tizaa, ve timuul tilam.
Isaav ighe tipul gabua toozi siriv izi Kanaan, na matazi ila pani sov. Pasaa, yau taug aat nayoli pa gabua popoia siriv to nugh tane.”
Yakop natŋa tila tigham uraat itaghon kinik aliiŋa le isov, ra Yosep igham lezi karis siriv, ve igham lezi tamaz paam.
Ve irei lezi nonoghiiŋa paghpaaghu le irau zi. Eemon Benyamin, Yosep igham le nonoghiiŋa paghpaaghu liim, ve maet silva irau ndiŋndiŋ tol (300).

Yosep ipadid gabua popoiazi to Isip izala doŋki zitamoot saŋavul pavozi, ve iyambaar zi ila pa taama Yakop. Ve iyambaar doŋki upin saŋavul tomania aniiŋ maata maata paam. Leso saawe tau timuul tilam, mako imin tamaz pa taama.
Ra Yosep ighur tooghŋa ve taazi tila. Ve isaav pazi ighe: “Ala ve akokook izi eez livuugha sov.”
Tauvene yes tipul taan to Isip, ve tilaagh tila tivot to tamazi Yakop izi Kanaan.

Ra tipaes pani tighe: “Tamamai, ulooŋ! Natum Yosep, i imaat mako. Ilepleep ta Isip we. Ve i imin tiina, ve iŋgin taan isov to Isip.” Yakop ilooŋ saveeŋ toozi, le irur ve ŋgar tooni imbool. Eemon ighur ila mako.
Ve saawe tau tipaesia Yosep aliiŋa pani, ve ighita karis tau Yosep iyambaar zi tila pazi leso tizaa ve tizila pa Isip na, tiini izaa ve loolo poia kat.
Tauvene isaav ighe: “Onoon kat. Ŋgarig gha naghur ila. Natug Yosep imaat mako. I ilepleep. Yau aat nala ve naghita pataghaaŋ. O ighe namaat, namaat lak!”
